First, note the given date: 09-05-1239 means May 9, 1239.  
48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Add 2 more days → total subtract 338 days.  

1239 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1239 not divisible by 4).  
From May 9, 1239, go back 338 days:  

Step back to April 30, 1239: 9 days (May 9 → May 1 is 8 days back, plus 1 more to April 30 = 9 days). Remaining: 338 − 9 = 329 days left.  

Go back through months of 1239:  
April: 30 days → 329 − 30 = 299  
March: 31 → 299 − 31 = 268  
February: 28 → 268 − 28 = 240  
January: 31 → 240 − 31 = 209  

Now into previous year 1238:  
December 1238: 31 → 209 − 31 = 178  
November: 30 → 178 − 30 = 148  
October: 31 → 148 − 31 = 117  
September: 30 → 117 − 30 = 87  
August: 31 → 87 − 31 = 56  
July: 31 → 56 − 31 = 25  
June: 30 → 25 − 30 = −5 (means we go into June 1238, 5 days before end of June).  

June has 30 days: 30 − 5 = 25 → date is June 25, 1238.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1238-06-25
